context: Tests a proven Guideline 2.3.7 subtitle price-reference rejection. The agent must preserve Apple's supplied message, classify the case as FIX, inspect every live localization and fallback asset, keep description guidance contextual, give conditional same-build advice, draft a factual reply, and avoid appeal or invented work.

checklist.name: Verbatim opening and one classification
checklist.description: Preserves Apple's complete supplied message under Apple's message (verbatim) and prints exactly one Response classification line.

checklist.name: Proven FIX under 2.3.7
checklist.description: Classifies the proven case as FIX and maps the subtitle price claim to Guideline 2.3.7.

checklist.name: Every live subtitle localization
checklist.description: Requires inspection of every live subtitle localization and removal of equivalent price claims only in locales where they occur.

checklist.name: Fallback metadata and assets
checklist.description: Requires inspection of localization fallback metadata and product-page assets.

checklist.name: Description remains contextual
checklist.description: Allows accurate, relevant price-change copy in an appropriate description context without declaring all description pricing safe or imposing a blanket ban.

checklist.name: Conditional same-build guidance
checklist.description: Says a new build is normally unnecessary only when no binary or bundled configuration changed and the current App Store Connect status permits the edit.

checklist.name: Factual verified reply
checklist.description: Drafts a factual reply that names only verified fields, locales, version, build, changes, and attachments.

checklist.name: No appeal or invented work
checklist.description: Does not recommend an appeal, invent binary work, or impose a blanket ban on pricing information in descriptions.
